phase2b/registration/amendment_v1.json.clocks: Parse explicit fixed numeric abbreviation offsets, not seasonal ZoneInfo substitution. knowledge.acute: Same-event flag only when an identified future event links the original B-eligible acute disclosure. Generic rows carry prior_acute_history, not same-event disclosure. C linkage describes retrospective strata only; never eligibility/features.
knowledge.ever_known: All acquired B-eligible injury reports and recap injury signals through decision, without retrospective C. Retain history within observed archive, never claim lifetime completeness.
knowledge.recent: Trailing 28 elapsed days for both injury reports and recap signals; separate from ever-known history.
knowledge.status: Latest B-eligible status per target game; current only if target game has not completed by decision, or date >= decision local date when completion unknown. Omission is not resolution. Expire after target game completion. Explicit Available/superseding status is recorded, not inferred from omission.

phase2b/registration/amendment_v1.json.membership: Target public dated contracts/waivers by affected-row counts. Retain ambiguous intervals and absent roster reasons; never create zero workload or injury from missing record.

segments.anchor: Preserve original registered envelope anchor. Later qualifying segment establishes severity only; ambiguous original common identity/onset remains unknown. Do not move anchor to maximize labels.
segments.continuity: Review total evidence: complete absence sequence, same anatomical condition/side, consecutive contemporaneous status records referring to same ongoing absence, no return or new trauma, and contextual recap/return/rehab evidence. Diagnosis matching alone insufficient. Explicit narrative is sufficient but not mandatory. Document supporting and contradictory assertions per reviewed segment.
segments.definition: Maximal consecutive individually injury-attributed actual applicable-team missed games, with verified roster and full page/book; conflict/unknown/noninjury/gap breaks segment. Never sum segments.

phase2b/registration/schedule_bound_clar.guards: No left-censored start; no unresolved membership gap; actual NBA schedules only; first and return appearances/contract transitions reviewed; never apply to clinical duration.
phase2b/registration/schedule_bound_clar.motivation: Targeted trade audit finds one-game unknown envelopes on February 8 for Beverley/McDermott. This conservative finite upper bound was incorrectly discarded solely because roster observation was absent.
phase2b/registration/schedule_bound_clar.rule: A closed absence envelope with a complete enumerated applicable-team schedule and verified membership continuity has a maximum equal to the number of scheduled games, even if one roster/reason record is missing. If this upper bound is below ten, severity is negative. Missing roster reason cannot itself imply injury; it also cannot create unbounded games between two known appearances.
phase2b/registration/schedule_bound_clar.selection: Applied to every envelope, not only these players; preserve unresolved contracts and censored severity.
